card.title: I Packed for You
card.instruction: Take care of practical needs before anyone asks, then resist choices that make your preparation unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed lunches for your first week at college.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My room doesn't have a fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll drop one off every morning. I've labelled the days.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lunch is included in my fees. I'm meeting my flatmates there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How many flatmates? I'll pack theirs too. You can all meet me outside.
